context:
You asked, 15:02 CDT: what does 'nothing is built yet' mean, when Banchi is a full app? You are right; that line was wrong. Banchi already stores the number as Place.slot (store/master.py, decision D58), and its screens already say 'empty slot'. So b needs no data change: only screen and doc wording, size unmeasured. The code type may stay named Place. Read on banchi main by the coordinator, 15:06 CDT.

You asked, 14:45 CDT: isn't this part of the glossary work, one name per thing? Yes; this item only asks which word. Your pick lands in Banchi's glossary.

Goal: one plain word for where a card sits, so you and the helper say the same thing. Problem: the d4 brief says 'place', Banchi's code and screens say 'slot'; the word on your screens is yours to pick. Based on: the v3 notes item 8 (read); Banchi store/master.py Place.slot (read).
